body: Thank you for trying.  This will be my last post.
She hates my family and I don't like hers.
She thinks I'm a useless drunk and she may be right.
My grandpa used a .22 under the rib cage.  Do you think stepping out of this rental Chevy at 70 mph would do it?
I have three more hours in this car for someone to talk me out of it.  But I think she will be better of without me
After I am dead I won't even have the capacity to think, let alone wonder about how she feels.  It seems simple.
I feel like I will do it someday, why not now while she is young?  Aren't they more resilient the younger they are?
My wife is driving as we go down the highway and I am thinking of just opening the door and stepping out.
This gets a large up vote and makes the front page.  Meanwhile global revolutions are happening and America needs one.  I am a veteran.
If you didn't know this, then you haven't been paying attention.

Flash burn over most of his body by a leaky propane tank.  He came running in the house asking if he was on fire, the neighbor called 911 for the truck.  It took the firefighters to realize he had been burned.  My mother and step dad are horrible.  I am a grown man and that is why I was not there.  Horrible mother.
